description: Defines the SimpleSessionNotifier class, a test utility implementing session management, stream data handling, and control frame management for QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: SimpleSessionNotifier
classes.description: A test implementation of a session notifier managing stream data and control frames for QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: StreamState
classes.description: Represents the state of a stream, including total bytes, sent bytes, acknowledged offsets, and retransmission info.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with a QuicConnection pointer.

methods.description: Destructor.
